title: Accounts Assistant
description:
A growing business in the renewable energy sector is looking for a proactive Accounts Assistant with a strong eye for detail to join its team in Stockport. The role is part-time (20 hours per week) and permanent.There is flexibility for days/hours worked.

It would suit someone with solid sales ledger and credit control experience who likes keeping accounts in order and is happy to help with wider admin and operational work.

The Accounts Assistant Role
- Managing the full sales ledger: raising and issuing invoices, allocating payments and chasing outstanding balances
- Running credit control: monitoring aged debt, following up overdue accounts by phone and email, and escalating where needed
- Handling day-to-day finance admin, including data entry, document management and bank reconciliations
- Supporting the purchase ledger as required
- Keeping sales ledger records accurate and helping prepare information for month-end reporting
- Providing general admin support across the team

About You
- Previous experience as an Accounts Assistant or in a similar role
- Strong sales ledger background with a track record in debt collection and credit control
- Confident chasing payments by phone and email
- Skilled in Xero
- Highly organised, with excellent attention to detail
- A proactive team player with a can-do attitude
- Experience in purchasing or working with operational teams would be an advantage

What's on Offer
- 30,000 pro rata (based on 20 hours per week)
- Quarterly bonus
- Free on-site parking
- A varied role in a supportive, growing business
- Opportunities to grow and develop

If this sounds like you, apply today with your CV.

description:

Previous experience in a customer facing role (such as within retail, hospitality or similar where you have provided customer-support) is a strong advantage. Full, ongoing training and support is provided.

title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
Full-time and Part-time roles available

The Role

We are looking for a confident and customer-focused Customer Service Advisor to join a busy and supportive team.

This is a varied role where you will be responsible for providing a high standard of service, responding to customer queries and ensuring issues are resolved efficiently and accurately. You will build positive relationships with customers, take ownership of queries from start to finish and work closely with internal teams to ensure a smooth customer experience.

The ideal candidate will be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, have excellent attention to detail and enjoy helping people. You'll need to be organised, professional and confident communicating with customers across different channels.

Key Responsibilities
- Act as a key point of contact for customers, responding to queries by phone, email and other communication channels.
- Build and maintain positive relationships with customers, providing a professional and helpful service at all times.
- Take ownership of customer queries and ensure they are followed through to resolution.
- Investigate issues, identify appropriate solutions and escalate more complex matters where necessary.
- Provide accurate information and guidance to customers in a clear and professional manner.
- Keep customer records and internal systems up to date.
- Work collaboratively with colleagues and other teams to resolve queries efficiently.
- Identify recurring issues and contribute to improvements in the overall customer experience.
- Manage a varied workload while maintaining accuracy and meeting agreed service standards.
- Handle sensitive or confidential information appropriately.
- Support the wider team with administrative and customer-related tasks when required.

About You

We're looking for someone who:
- Has previous experience in a customer service, client services or customer-facing role.
- Is confident communicating with people over the phone and in writing.
- Has excellent attention to detail and takes pride in getting things right.
- Can manage multiple queries and priorities in a busy environment.
- Is naturally helpful, approachable and solutions-focused.
- Can remain calm and professional when dealing with challenging queries.
- Is comfortable using computer systems and learning new software quickly.
- Takes ownership and doesn't wait to be told when something needs resolving.
- Works well as part of a team but is equally comfortable managing their own workload.

- Excellent spoken and written English
- A confident and professional telephone manner
- Strong communication and listening skills
- A patient, empathetic and customer-focused approach
- Confident handling payments and sensitive conversations
- Comfortable supporting customers who may need additional time and guidance
- Reliable, professional and able to work well as part of a team

- Opportunity to work for a fantastic organisation and gain valuable experience
- A rewarding role where you can genuinely make a difference to customers

If this sounds like a Customer Service Advisor role you will LOVE and you're available from 24 September, we'd LOVE to hear from you. Apply today!

title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
Kinaxia are recruiting a Customer Service Advisor to join their team at their site in Stockport. The role of the Customer Service Advisor will be to provide and promote a professional, customer focused service to ensure that the needs of customers are being satisfied and a world class service is being delivered and promoted across the Company.
- Monday - Friday
- 45 hours per week
- Additional benefits:
- Life assurance
- Pension
- Exceptional fleet
- Full Uniform and PPE
- Onsite Parking
- Employee Assistance Programme
- Loyalty Awards (recognises employees with 5, 10, 20, 30 and 40 years service)

About the job:

title: HR and Office Coordinator
description:
Your new company

A well-established and growing organisation is seeking a personable and proactive HR & Office Administrator to join its team. This is a varied, fully office-based role supporting the day-to-day running of a professional office environment.

Your new role
As HR & Office Administrator, you will provide key support across both HR and office functions, ensuring efficient administration and a professional working environment.

What you'll need to succeed
To be successful in this role, you will have previous administration experience, ideally with exposure to HR administration, personnel records or confidential documentation.
- Strong organisational and administrative skills
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy
- The ability to handle sensitive and confidential information professionally
- A proactive and self-motivated approach to work
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills
- Confidence working independently and researching information when required
- A flexible attitude and willingness to support a variety of office activities

What you'll get in return
You'll receive an excellent salary up to 30,000 depending on experience. You will also receive an excellent benefits package including holidays, pension, medical, free parking and more.

title: IVA Administrator
description:
Corporate Insolvency Administrator

Location: Stockport

Salary: Competitive + Benefits

Imperium Financial Recruitment are acting as an agency on behalf of a well-established and highly regarded insolvency practice in Stockport, who are seeking to recruit a Corporate Insolvency Administrator to join their growing team.

This opportunity is suitable for either:
- An experienced Corporate Insolvency Administrator, or
- An IVA Administrator looking to transition into the corporate insolvency sector.

The successful candidate will work on a varied portfolio of corporate insolvency cases, with duties including closures and variations, alongside wider case administration responsibilities. The firm offers a supportive environment with genuine long-term progression opportunities.

For experienced candidates, the role can be office-based, hybrid, or fully remote.

Key Responsibilities:
- Managing corporate insolvency cases from inception through to closure
- Preparing closure documentation and handling case variations
- Liaising with directors, creditors, solicitors and other stakeholders
- Drafting reports and statutory documentation
- Supporting senior staff on a range of insolvency matters
- Ensuring all casework is compliant with current insolvency legislation and procedures

Requirements:
- Previous experience within corporate insolvency or IVA administration
- Strong organisational and communication skills
- Ability to manage workloads and meet deadlines effectively
- A professional and proactive approach to case management

This is an excellent opportunity to join a respected firm offering flexibility, stability, and career development within a successful insolvency team.

For further information or to apply confidentially, please contact Imperium Financial Recruitment.

title: Pallet Network & Customer Service Coordinator
description:
Are you passionate about delivering excellent customer service while keeping transport operations running smoothly?

We're looking for a Pallet Network & Customer Service Coordinator to join our busy transport team based in Stockport. This is a varied role that combines operational planning with customer relationship management, making it ideal for someone who enjoys problem-solving, building relationships, and working in a fast-paced environment. The role involves coordinating pallet network collections and deliveries, managing customer enquiries, and working closely with drivers and operational teams to ensure an outstanding service is delivered every day.

- Managing customer bookings and service enquiries.

- Building strong relationships with customers, drivers, and internal teams.
- Monitoring deliveries and proactively resolving any service issues.
- Providing transport quotations and processing customer bookings.
- Maintaining accurate records using transport and customer management systems.
- Supporting key customer accounts and helping to improve customer satisfaction.
- Working collaboratively with transport, warehouse and customer service teams to deliver operational excellence.

What We're Looking For
- Excellent communication and customer service skills.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to prioritise multiple tasks.
- A proactive approach to problem-solving.
- Good IT skills and confidence using business systems.
- The ability to build positive working relationships with colleagues and customers.
- Previous experience within transport, logistics, distribution, customer service or a similar operational environment would be beneficial.

We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender identity, marriage or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, or sexual orientation.

Ready to Apply?

If you're looking for an opportunity where no two days are the same and you can make a real difference to both customers and operations, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Payroll Coordinator
description:
The Role

We are looking for an experienced Payroll Specialist to join a busy team, responsible for the accurate and timely processing of payroll while providing a high level of customer service.

Key Responsibilities
- Process payroll accurately and within agreed deadlines.
- Manage payroll information from input through to completion.
- Process starters, leavers and employee changes.
- Calculate pay, deductions and adjustments accurately.
- Handle payroll queries professionally and efficiently.
- Investigate discrepancies and take ownership through to resolution.
- Maintain accurate payroll records and employee information.
- Complete payroll checks and reconciliations.
- Ensure statutory requirements and payroll procedures are followed.
- Process PAYE, National Insurance and other relevant deductions.
- Support pension and auto-enrolment processes.
- Assist with statutory payments and payroll-related administration.
- Work closely with internal teams to resolve payroll issues.
- Provide clear and accurate information to customers and employees.
- Manage a high-volume workload while maintaining accuracy.
- Handle sensitive and confidential information appropriately.
- Meet payroll deadlines and maintain strong attention to detail.
- Keep up to date with relevant payroll legislation and changes.
- Identify opportunities to improve payroll processes and efficiency.
- Contribute positively to a collaborative, customer-focused team.

About You
- Previous experience in a payroll position.
- Good knowledge of UK payroll processes and legislation.
- Excellent attention to detail and numerical accuracy.
- Strong communication and customer service skills.
- Ability to work under pressure and meet strict deadlines.
- Organised, proactive and confident managing your own workload.
- Comfortable using payroll systems and Microsoft Office.
- Professional and confidential approach.
